label: Extron DTP3 CrossPoint 662 IPCP A SL

_avail.description: 4K/60 Presentation Matrix Switcher with Reversible DTP3 I/O, Control Processor, Amplifier and ShareLink

portsSource.label: Extron DTP3 CrossPoint 662 IPCP A SL

ports.label: HDMI Input 1
ports.notes: HDMI 2.0b / DVI 1.0, HDCP 2.3. Up to 4K @ 60Hz 4:2:0 12-bit, 4K @ 30Hz 4:4:4 8-bit, or 1080p @ 60Hz 4:4:4 10-bit (18 Gbps max, 6 Gbps per color). De-embedded LPCM audio feeds the audio matrix.

ports.notes: HDMI 2.0b / DVI 1.0, HDCP 2.3. Up to 4K @ 60Hz 4:2:0 12-bit, 4K @ 30Hz 4:4:4 8-bit, or 1080p @ 60Hz 4:4:4 10-bit (18 Gbps max, 6 Gbps per color). De-embedded LPCM audio feeds the audio matrix.

ports.label: Selectable Input 1 (HDMI)
ports.notes: Selectable HDMI/DTP3-XTP input 1 — HDMI side. Software-selectable between this HDMI port and the paired DTP3/XTP RJ-45 port; only one is active at a time. HDMI 2.0b, HDCP 2.3.

ports.label: Selectable In 1 (DTP3/XTP)
ports.notes: Selectable HDMI/DTP3-XTP input 1 — DTP3/XTP RJ-45 side. Software-selectable between this RJ-45 and the paired HDMI port. DTP3 carries HDMI + embedded audio + USB + RS-232 + remote power up to 330ft (100m) on shielded CATx; XTP / HDBT modes also supported. Backwards compatible with first-gen DTP endpoints up to 4K @ 30Hz 4:4:4 or 4K @ 60Hz 4:2:0.

ports.label: Selectable Input 2 (HDMI)
ports.notes: Selectable HDMI/DTP3-XTP input 2 — HDMI side. Software-selectable between this HDMI port and the paired DTP3/XTP RJ-45 port; only one is active at a time. HDMI 2.0b, HDCP 2.3.

ports.label: Selectable In 2 (DTP3/XTP)
ports.notes: Selectable HDMI/DTP3-XTP input 2 — DTP3/XTP RJ-45 side. Software-selectable between this RJ-45 and the paired HDMI port. DTP3 carries HDMI + embedded audio + USB + RS-232 + remote power up to 330ft (100m) on shielded CATx; XTP / HDBT modes also supported. Backwards compatible with first-gen DTP endpoints up to 4K @ 30Hz 4:4:4 or 4K @ 60Hz 4:2:0.

ports.label: DTP3 I/O 1
ports.notes: Configurable DTP3/XTP/HDBT input OR output (with scaling — switchable via software). DTP3 mode supports HDMI + embedded audio + USB + RS-232 + remote power up to 330ft (100m) on shielded CATx. Direction is field-configured.; configurable input/output

ports.label: DTP3 I/O 2
ports.notes: Configurable DTP3/XTP/HDBT input OR output (with scaling — switchable via software). DTP3 mode supports HDMI + embedded audio + USB + RS-232 + remote power up to 330ft (100m) on shielded CATx. Direction is field-configured.; configurable input/output

ports.label: DTP3 Scaled Out 1
ports.notes: Scaled DTP3/XTP/HDBT buffered output with Vector 4K seamless scaling. Carries HDMI + embedded audio + RS-232 over shielded CATx up to 330ft (100m).; DTP3/XTP/HDBaseT

ports.label: DTP3/XTP/HDBT Scaled Out 2
ports.notes: Scaled DTP3/XTP/HDBT buffered output with Vector 4K seamless scaling. Carries HDMI + embedded audio + RS-232 over shielded CATx up to 330ft (100m).

ports.label: DTP3/XTP/HDBT Scaled Out 3
ports.notes: Scaled DTP3/XTP/HDBT buffered output with Vector 4K seamless scaling. Carries HDMI + embedded audio + RS-232 over shielded CATx up to 330ft (100m).

ports.label: DTP3/XTP/HDBT Scaled Out 4
ports.notes: Scaled DTP3/XTP/HDBT buffered output with Vector 4K seamless scaling. Carries HDMI + embedded audio + RS-232 over shielded CATx up to 330ft (100m).

ports.label: HDMI Out 1 (Buffered Mirror)
ports.notes: Scaled HDMI buffered output that mirrors a DTP3 RJ-45 output. HDMI 2.0, HDCP 2.3.

ports.label: HDMI Out 2 (Buffered Mirror)
ports.notes: Scaled HDMI buffered output that mirrors a DTP3 RJ-45 output. HDMI 2.0, HDCP 2.3.

ports.label: HDMI Output 1 (Scaled)
ports.notes: Scaled HDMI output (independent routing). HDMI 2.0, HDCP 2.3.

ports.label: HDMI Output 2 (Scaled)
ports.notes: Scaled HDMI output (independent routing). HDMI 2.0, HDCP 2.3.

ports.label: Mic/Line Input 1
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 6-pole captive screw (shared with another channel — 2 channels per captive). -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +60 dB input gain in 0.1 dB steps. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: Mic/Line Input 2
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 6-pole captive screw (shared with another channel — 2 channels per captive). -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +60 dB input gain in 0.1 dB steps. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: Mic/Line Input 3
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 6-pole captive screw (shared with another channel — 2 channels per captive). -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +60 dB input gain in 0.1 dB steps. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: Mic/Line Input 4
ports.notes: Mono mic/line balanced/unbalanced input on 3.5mm 6-pole captive screw (shared with another channel — 2 channels per captive). -60 dBV mic / +4 dBu line / -10 dBV consumer. -18 to +60 dB input gain in 0.1 dB steps. +48VDC switchable phantom power.

ports.label: Audio Input — Line 1 (Mono)
ports.notes: Mono balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 6-pole captive screw (shared with another channel; the captive is field-configurable as 2 mono OR 1 stereo). +4 dBu / -10 dBV nominal. -18 to +24 dB input gain in 1 dB steps.

ports.label: Audio Input — Line 2 (Mono)
ports.notes: Mono balanced/unbalanced analog line-level input on 3.5mm 6-pole captive screw (shared with another channel; the captive is field-configurable as 2 mono OR 1 stereo). +4 dBu / -10 dBV nominal. -18 to +24 dB input gain in 1 dB steps.

ports.label: Audio Output — Line 1 (Mono)
ports.notes: Mono variable balanced/unbalanced analog line-level output on 3.5mm 6-pole captive screw (shared with another channel; configurable as 2 mono OR 1 stereo). >+21 dBu max balanced, +15 dBu max unbalanced. 0 to -100 dB volume.

ports.label: Audio Output — Line 2 (Mono)
ports.notes: Mono variable balanced/unbalanced analog line-level output on 3.5mm 6-pole captive screw (shared with another channel; configurable as 2 mono OR 1 stereo). >+21 dBu max balanced, +15 dBu max unbalanced. 0 to -100 dB volume.

ports.label: Amp Out (L)
ports.notes: Class D power amplifier output. Stereo mode: 100W rms per channel into 4Ω or 8Ω. Bridged mono mode (field config): 200W rms into 8Ω, or 200W rms into 70V/100V constant-voltage line. 5mm 4-pole captive screw (L+/L-/R+/R-) — same captive whether stereo or bridged. Per-channel modeled (bridge mode is a field option not visible at variant level).

ports.label: Amp Out (R)
ports.notes: Class D power amplifier output. Stereo mode: 100W rms per channel into 4Ω or 8Ω. Bridged mono mode (field config): 200W rms into 8Ω, or 200W rms into 70V/100V constant-voltage line. 5mm 4-pole captive screw (L+/L-/R+/R-) — same captive whether stereo or bridged. Per-channel modeled (bridge mode is a field option not visible at variant level).

ports.label: LAN A (Switcher)
ports.notes: 10/100/1000Base-T LAN A on the switcher. DHCP enabled by default; default static 192.168.253.249. 802.1X security. Independent from IPCP control-processor LAN ports on IPCP variants.

ports.label: LAN B (Switcher)
ports.notes: 10/100/1000Base-T LAN B on the switcher. DHCP off by default; default static 192.168.252.249. 802.1X security. Independent from IPCP control-processor LAN ports on IPCP variants.

ports.label: IPCP House LAN
ports.notes: 10/100/1000Base-T house LAN port on the integrated IPCP 360M Q xi control processor. Links to the customer's main network.

ports.label: IPCP AV LAN 1
ports.notes: 10/100/1000Base-T isolated AV LAN port on the integrated IPCP 360M Q xi. PoE+ supported on this port (powers downstream PoE+ devices).

ports.label: IPCP AV LAN 2
ports.notes: 10/100/1000Base-T isolated AV LAN port on the integrated IPCP 360M Q xi. PoE+ supported on this port (powers downstream PoE+ devices).

ports.label: IPCP AV LAN 3
ports.notes: 10/100/1000Base-T isolated AV LAN port on the integrated IPCP 360M Q xi.

ports.label: Dante AT — Primary
ports.notes: Primary (with PoE) Dante / AES67 audio transport RJ-45 on 1 Gbps 2-port switch. 32 channels Tx + 32 channels Rx. Uncompressed 24-bit/48kHz. Software-selectable Dante or AES67 mode. Latency selectable: 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0 (default) / 2.0 / 5.0 ms.

ports.label: Dante AT — Secondary
ports.notes: Secondary Dante / AES67 audio transport RJ-45 on 1 Gbps 2-port switch. 32 channels Tx + 32 channels Rx. Uncompressed 24-bit/48kHz. Software-selectable Dante or AES67 mode. Latency selectable: 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0 (default) / 2.0 / 5.0 ms.

ports.label: RS-232 Pass-Thru
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 over the DTP3 link via Ethernet insertion. 3.5mm 3-pole captive (Pin 1=Tx, 2=Rx, 3=Gnd). 300-115200 baud. (DTP3 has no IR pass-through ports — different from older DTP/DTP CrossPoint generations.)

ports.label: IPCP RS-232/422/485 Port 1
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 / RS-422 / RS-485 (software-selectable) on 3.5mm 5-pole captive. Hardware + software flow control. 300-115200 baud.

ports.label: IPCP RS-232 Port 2
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 on 3.5mm 3-pole captive. Software flow control. 300-115200 baud.

ports.label: IPCP RS-232 Port 3
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 on 3.5mm 3-pole captive. Software flow control. 300-115200 baud.

ports.label: IPCP IR/Serial 1
ports.notes: Programmable IR (carrier or non-carrier, 30 kHz - 1 MHz) or unidirectional RS-232 +5V output on 3.5mm captive. Per-channel modeled — both ports share a single 5-pole captive screw block.

ports.label: IPCP IR/Serial 2
ports.notes: Programmable IR (carrier or non-carrier, 30 kHz - 1 MHz) or unidirectional RS-232 +5V output on 3.5mm captive. Per-channel modeled — both ports share a single 5-pole captive screw block.

ports.label: IPCP Relay 1
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1A max) on 3.5mm 3-pole captive (2 relays share each 3-pole captive — DTP3 uses 2 separate 3-pole captives for the 4 relays, vs older generations' single 6-pole captive). Per-channel modeled.

ports.label: IPCP Relay 2
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1A max) on 3.5mm 3-pole captive (2 relays share each 3-pole captive — DTP3 uses 2 separate 3-pole captives for the 4 relays, vs older generations' single 6-pole captive). Per-channel modeled.

ports.label: IPCP Relay 3
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1A max) on 3.5mm 3-pole captive (2 relays share each 3-pole captive — DTP3 uses 2 separate 3-pole captives for the 4 relays, vs older generations' single 6-pole captive). Per-channel modeled.

ports.label: IPCP Relay 4
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1A max) on 3.5mm 3-pole captive (2 relays share each 3-pole captive — DTP3 uses 2 separate 3-pole captives for the 4 relays, vs older generations' single 6-pole captive). Per-channel modeled.

ports.label: IPCP Digital I/O 1
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive. Input: 0-24 VDC, 28kΩ impedance, programmable 2kΩ pullup to +5V. Output: 250mA sink from 24V max. Per-channel modeled — 4 channels share a single 5-pole captive.

ports.label: IPCP Digital I/O 2
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive. Input: 0-24 VDC, 28kΩ impedance, programmable 2kΩ pullup to +5V. Output: 250mA sink from 24V max. Per-channel modeled — 4 channels share a single 5-pole captive.

ports.label: IPCP Digital I/O 3
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive. Input: 0-24 VDC, 28kΩ impedance, programmable 2kΩ pullup to +5V. Output: 250mA sink from 24V max. Per-channel modeled — 4 channels share a single 5-pole captive.

ports.label: IPCP Digital I/O 4
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive. Input: 0-24 VDC, 28kΩ impedance, programmable 2kΩ pullup to +5V. Output: 250mA sink from 24V max. Per-channel modeled — 4 channels share a single 5-pole captive.

ports.label: DMP EXP
ports.notes: Extron proprietary DMP EXP audio expansion bus on RJ-45. 16ch Tx + 16ch Rx, 24-bit/48kHz uncompressed. Links a second Extron DSP for I/O expansion. Shielded CAT 6 up to 10m. Modeled as `aes` + `rj45` per project convention (no `extron-exp` SignalType in src/types.ts).

ports.label: USB-C Audio (Rear)
ports.notes: Rear-panel USB-C audio interface. USB 2.0 high speed. Configurable as 0x6, 6x0, 2x2, 2x4, or 4x2 in/out channel count. Hosts a DAW or PC for soft-codec (Zoom/Teams/Webex) audio routing.

ports.label: USB 3.0
ports.notes: Rear, Communication; Rear-panel USB 3.0 (USB 3.1 Gen 1, 5 Gbps) Type A communication port. Compatible USB 1.0/1.1/2.0. 900 mA max source current.

ports.label: USB-C Configuration (Front)
ports.notes: Front-panel USB-C configuration port. IP over USB-C, USB 2.0 high speed.

ports.label: AC Mains
ports.notes: Internal universal-input PSU. 100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, IEC C14 inlet.
